```yaml
name: Update Ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-ingestr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 'latest'
          check-latest: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Check for new Ingestr release
        id: check-release
        run: |
          curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name'

      - name: Compare versions
        id: compare-versions
        run: |
          current_version=$(cat go.mod | grep "ingestr" | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"')
          latest_version=${{ steps.check-release.outputs.stdout }}
          if [ "$current_version" != "$latest_version" ]; then
            echo "::set-output name=update_needed::true"
            echo "New Ingestr version available: $latest_version"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=update_needed::false"
            echo "No new Ingestr version available."
          fi

      - name: Create or update PR comment
        if: steps.compare-versions.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        uses: edumserrano/find-create-or-update-comment@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: bruin-data/bruin
          issue-number: 1
          comment-author: github-actions[bot]
          body-includes: "Ingestr version update needed"
          body: |
            A new version of Ingestr is available. Please update the `ingestrVersion` in `go.mod` to `$latest_version`.
          direction: last
          nth: 1
          edit-mode: replace
          reactions: thumbs_up

      - name: Bump Ingestr version
        if: steps.compare-versions.outputs.update_needed == 'true'
        run: |
          sed -i '' "s|ingestr v.*|ingestr v${{ steps.check-release.outputs.stdout }}|" go.mod
          git add go.mod
          git commit -m "Bump Ingestr version to ${{ steps.check-release.outputs.stdout }}"
          git push origin main
```
